games:2026-wk11-florida-kentucky.blurb: No. 11 Kentucky is only a field goal favorite at home against an unranked Florida team, and ESPN's model makes it nearly a coin flip at 53.8%. With a 52.5 total, this looks like the kind of grind-it-out night where one possession decides whether the Wildcats hold their spot.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-south-carolina.blurb: No. 17 South Carolina goes on the road as a 7.5-point favorite at Arkansas, a rare spot where the visitor is the heavy side at 77.2% per ESPN. A loss here would be the kind of result that erases weeks of ranking progress for the Gamecocks.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-purdue-iowa.blurb: No. 15 Iowa is a 17.5-point home favorite over Purdue, the biggest spread involving a ranked team outside South Bend, with ESPN at 87.1%. Iowa is on the bubble and needs the convincing version of this win.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky slid from No. 6 to No. 11, and the advanced numbers aren't rushing to defend the Wildcats -- 41st in SP+ and 35th in FPI. A narrow home spot against Florida is a chance to stop the slide, or to fall a lot further.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa sits last among the bubble four at the 16 seed, four spots from the field, though a four-place jump says the arrow is pointing up.

games:2026-wk11-utah-arizona.blurb: No. 2 Utah is barely favored on the road at No. 23 Arizona, laying just 1.5 with ESPN giving the Utes a 60% shot in a game with a modest 55.5 total. A Big 12 title path that looked clean gets a lot muddier if the Wildcats cash as near coin-flip home dogs.

games:2026-wk11-texas-lsu.blurb: No. 21 LSU is a 4.5-point home favorite over No. 6 Texas, and ESPN's model agrees it's essentially a toss-up at 52.6-47.4. With the total sitting at 46.5, expect a grinder where one defensive stop decides a game Texas can't afford to lose.

games:2026-wk11-texas-tech-oklahoma-stat.blurb: No. 25 Oklahoma State is a 3.5-point home favorite over No. 12 Texas Tech with a sky-high 73.5 total, so points shouldn't be hard to come by. ESPN has it at 51.5-48.5, and the Red Raiders' spot just inside the bubble conversation rides on it.

games:2026-wk11-usc-indiana.blurb: No. 9 Indiana is a 9.5-point home favorite over No. 18 USC, with ESPN giving the Hoosiers a 78% chance. Indiana is chasing the Big Ten leaders and can't afford a slip; the Trojans need a road upset to stay relevant.

games:2026-wk11-illinois-ucla.blurb: No. 4 UCLA survived a rain-soaked scare to stay perfect, beating Illinois 22-14 after Ty Dieffenbach left with a left elbow injury before halftime and returned in the third quarter to a roar. Dieffenbach threw for 232 yards and two scores, including a 54-yarder to Aidan Mizell and a 26-yarder to Semaj Morgan, while Scooter Jackson's second interception with 2:50 left sealed it as the Illini gave it away three times.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-missouri-georg.blurb: No. 1 Georgia hosts No. 22 Missouri as a 16.5-point favorite, with ESPN giving the Bulldogs an 88.8% shot. The total is just 48.5, suggesting Missouri's best hope is slowing this down into a rock fight.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-ole-miss-oklah.blurb: Oklahoma is a 2.5-point home favorite over No. 19 Ole Miss, though ESPN actually leans Rebels at 57.4%. Ole Miss, freshly dropped to 19th, needs this one to stop the slide.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-michigan-orego.blurb: No. 16 Oregon is a 10-point home favorite over Michigan with an eye-catching 39.5 total, the lowest on the board. ESPN gives the Ducks an 85.7% chance as they try to keep climbing the Big Ten ladder.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-wake-forest-sm.blurb: No. 13 Wake Forest goes to SMU as a 2.5-point underdog in a game with a 60.5 total. The Demon Deacons are chasing Miami in the ACC, and a road loss here would stall that pursuit in a hurry.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-houston-colora.blurb: Colorado stunned No. 14 Houston 42-32 in Boulder, rallying from a 20-7 deficit late in the first half with 28 unanswered points and four touchdowns of 32 yards or more. DeKalon Taylor's 67-yard run and Joseph Williams' 53-yard catch from Isaac Wilson keyed the surge, and backup Kaneal Sweetwyne scored on his first snap after Wilson limped off; the Cougars' two turnovers and late two-point failures left them chasing all night.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-northwestern-o.blurb: No. 20 Ohio State lays 14 at home against Northwestern with the total at 45.5. After tumbling eight spots in the rankings, the Buckeyes need a convincing afternoon to steady things.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-baylor-byu.blurb: No. 10 BYU hosts Baylor as an 8.5-point favorite, with ESPN giving the Cougars a 68.1% chance. BYU is the closest thing Utah has to a Big 12 chaser, so style points matter here.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-alabama-vander.blurb: No. 3 Alabama is a 15.5-point favorite at Vanderbilt with the total set at 48.5. The Crimson Tide are trailing Georgia in the SEC race and can't afford to let a road trip get interesting.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-duke-miami.blurb: No. 7 Miami hosts Duke as a 14-point favorite with a 55.5 total. The Hurricanes sit atop the ACC picture and simply need to handle their business.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-tennessee-texa.blurb: No. 8 Tennessee is only a 1.5-point favorite at Texas A&M, with ESPN giving the Vols a 58.6% edge in a game totaled at 43.5. A low-scoring road environment is the kind of spot that quietly derails a playoff case.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-boston-college.blurb: No. 5 Notre Dame is a 29.5-point home favorite over Boston College, and ESPN puts the Irish at 98.5%. This is a resume maintenance game and nothing more.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-oregon-state-b.blurb: No. 24 Boise State hosts Oregon State as a 16.5-point favorite with a 64.5 total and an 82.1% win probability per ESPN. The Broncos need the blowout to keep their ranking intact.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA jumped from eighth to fourth after staying unbeaten, though the analytics remain skeptical: SP+ has the Bruins 11th and FPI all the way down at 27th.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State slid from 12th to 20th in the rankings, but the models haven't budged much -- SP+ still has the Buckeyes third and FPI fifth, the widest gap between poll and metrics on the board.

predictions:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss fell from 10th to 19th, and the numbers aren't offering much of a defense: SP+ ranks the Rebels 30th, with FPI a more forgiving 12th.

predictions:oregon.blurb: Oregon climbed from 23rd to 16th, and the models think there's more room to run with SP+ at 15th and FPI at ninth.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: The SEC's auto bid is the tightest race in the sport: No. 1 Georgia and No. 3 Alabama are separated by just two spots, and neither has much margin for error.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: No. 4 UCLA holds the Big Ten's auto-bid position with No. 9 Indiana five spots back -- close enough that one Bruins stumble flips the league's representative.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 7 Miami leads the ACC race with No. 13 Wake Forest six spots behind, a gap that gives the Hurricanes breathing room but not comfort.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 2 Utah has the clearest conference lead of the four, sitting eight spots ahead of No. 10 BYU for the Big 12's automatic bid.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech sits at the 13 seed, one spot from the field after climbing three places, and gets the most direct test possible next: a trip to No. 25 Oklahoma State.

bubbleNotes:houston.blurb: Houston moved up three spots to the 15 seed but remains three spots outside the field, leaving little room for error the rest of the way.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest is trending the right way, up three to the 14 seed, but the Demon Deacons are still two spots shy of the bracket.
